purpose: Migration execution authority for Wave 5 (Academia) physical implementation. Distinct from docs/database/physical/wave5_manifest.json, which remains the design/decision authority (P0.3.5-A0/A0.1, commit 7f9a7dd) and is not modified by this file.

already_physical_other_wave.courses: Wave 4, apps/api/database/migrations/2026_09_16_000015_wave4_create_courses.php — NO_CHANGE required for Wave 5 (no new column referenced by any Wave 5 table beyond courses.id)

rollback_policy: Refuse rollback of any Wave 5 table while any Wave 5 table contains durable data (WAVE5_DURABLE_DATA_ROLLBACK_BLOCKED). Empty rollback drops only Wave 5, in reverse dependency order (Laravel's default), never touching Wave 1-4 tables.
cross_validation_rule: Every table listed here must appear in docs/database/physical/wave5_manifest.json's tables[].planned_table with decision != REJECTED and ready_for_migration == true. Every FK target referenced by these migrations that is not itself in this file's tables[] must already exist physically in Wave 1-4 (people, organizational_units, physical_locations, files, legal_documents, users, event_sessions) or Wave 4 (courses). Divergence is WAVE5_MANIFEST_CONFLICT, fail closed, not silently resolved.
